snippet.title: "Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL" - Official Reveal Trailer　 April 25, 2026
snippet.description:
[Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL] – Coming to Steam in Winter 2026!
Add to your Steam Wishlist here 🌠: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2860490/

―――――――――――――――――――――――――
Saved by a Goddess, you arrive in a ruined world ruled by the Demon King.
Gather resources, build facilities, swap hats to change your class, and assign villagers to their roles as you grow your settlement.
But beware… one night, a horde of frenzied monsters comes swarming into your village!?
―――――――――――――――――――――――――

⇒ Also coming to Nintendo Switch 2 and PS5 in 2027! 👏
